title: Bound all-cut precision for the completed P104 identity word
body:
## Summary

Supply the finite combined-word precision implication left open by [PR2139](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2139) and [PR2096 question 2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2096). All changes are under `research/p104-delayed-precision/`.

```text
Completed forward P104 identity word
  exact all-cut input coefficient P = 131072
  exact absolute-defect coefficient A = 1394705
  exact weighted-defect coefficient K = 2134050
  sufficient state-relative guard = 39 bits
```

The ideal endpoint maximum is only two. All three interior peaks occur after event 33373 in source93, whose input row is `-65536*(input86+input93)`. Input86 is an arbitrary dirty helper. Endpoint-only bounds therefore miss the transient.

Under the stated completed-instruction Hilbert defect contract, `u <= 2^(-b-39)` suffices for all-cut error at most `B*2^-b`, for every integer `b >= 0`. This is a sufficient local feedback estimate, not minimal numerical precision or an actual rounded-child implementation.

PR2139's complete construction is retained unchanged, including its unfavorable fixed-profile cost screen. No supplier, precision-charge reduction or new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

Before this contribution, PR2139 supplies a completed forward identity word but leaves precision open. PR2096's constants cover the different G/2 word and cannot be transferred here. After this contribution, the registered replay checks the complete combined stream and its signed all-cut sensitivity maps.

Observed on CPython 3.12.15, Linux x86_64, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-delayed-precision
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
```

- Every exported stream field regenerates from the unchanged PR2139 producer; its 241 new native recipes, 421 occurrence bindings and phase fault control pass.
- All 844 initial columns, every cut, arbitrary dirty restoration, private resets and the complete profile and rank mass 6782 pass. Cached norms are checked against direct coefficient-map reductions at every update.
- Separate Fraction reverse adjoints agree at the peak cuts and seven endpoints; sign-aligned executions attain the three coefficients.
- Nine behavior groups pass normally and with assertions disabled. Controls reject missing compensation/clear, illegal charts, corrupted receipts/words, changed producer code before import, capacity violations and overwrite attempts. Relocated default replay is read-only and needs no Git/network.
- All 65 repository research-workflow tests and selected source-binding orientation pass. This is not the selected cold replay or a hosted CI pass.

The sole task draw was `p104-side-correction`, nonce `159427fb87da401855d7b74679378fb5`, priority revision 4. TASK.json explicitly changes scope to this precision implication rather than another correction construction. Base and refreshed canonical main are `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. The final overlap check at 21:31 UTC covered 415 open PRs and 837 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings, not all diffs or unpublished work.

Credit Jose Manuel / PR2139, pinned at `1df674ca8e9d9e0fb98ba4df402b648e9b3be0a4`, for the entire completed construction. Credit Adam Gall / PR2096, pinned at `f22626f334a06f6e842766e4a6647419e6821d2d`, for the Hilbert-defect and feedback method on the older channel. The Rohan Arun, Chafik Boukhalfa, Ali Romman, Adam Gall, Josie Elliston, Clifford and selected Hamming/dirty-helper lineage is retained in NOTICE.md and the original predecessor files.

Coordination and handoff: [Discussion2121 claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2121#discussioncomment-18934115).

## Merge danger

**Door:** Two-way. This is an additive scoped research package with opt-in replay.

**Blast radius:** Local. No selected record, frozen predecessor, existing verifier or priority catalogue changes.

The native unitary-chart and completed-child defect contracts remain premises. Rounded recursive children, a fresh audit of every retained native recipe, global owners, the dual word, tape/all-size admission and independent human review remain open. The package includes concrete next questions; it does not establish a complete multiplication theorem.
